messages.subject: Define Modules
parts:
Hi all! I tried to define two modules and choose in a iteractive way to evaluate modularity in my 2D data set but i have an error message: 
Input must be a p-x-k matrix of landmark coordinate. I used the procustes coordinates of my data set and then I tried without procustes coordinates and i got the same error message. 
I tried this way because I have not continuous landmarks to choose, for example:
X<-rep(“a”,21); x[22:37]<-“b” 
I do not how i made by hand because the landmarks that I have to choose does not the same of the example

Thanks!

messages.author: f16866fc42d43e64
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Define Modules
parts:
Emanuel,

if your landmark modules are not in continuous numbers, you can create the vector of modules by hand, e.g.:

modules <- c("a", "a", "b", "a", "b", "b", "b", "a") 

and so on.

However, if your error is about the landmark coordinates, could it be that your A is not adequately formatted?

Hope this helps
Antigoni
